answer: Someone running 168 aliases therefore needs 40 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are written down in karst, expire in anchor, and vertex lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 13 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 2244 identities would post 4664 proofs and burn roughly 54 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
